name: Warm Caribbean Johnny Cake Cornbread with Mango Dip (Pirate Night Bread Service)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Made from finely ground degermed cornmeal and white flour with zero whole corn kernels—soft, slightly sweet, and easy to digest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm with plain butter or a dab of the smooth mango dip (verify no chili flakes are added to the dip).
watchOuts: High-fructose mango dip in large quantities
